mechanism: Nitrofurantoin may inhibit monoamine oxidase and phenelzine is an irreversible MAOI, creating potential for serotonergic effects and hypertensive crisis if nitrofurantoin has any sympathomimetic or monoamine-releasing properties.
action: Use alternative antibiotic if possible; if nitrofurantoin is necessary, monitor blood pressure closely and educate patient on hypertensive crisis symptoms.
